questions.corrige_markdown: **Holozoic nutrition** is the type of heterotrophic nutrition in which an organism **ingests solid food** (complex organic matter), **digests** it inside the body, **absorbs** the soluble products, **assimilates** them and **egests** the undigested remains, e.g. in humans, dogs and *Amoeba*.

questions.enonce_markdown: How is the ileum adapted for absorption of soluble food? *(8 marks)*
questions.corrige_markdown:
- It is **very long** (about 6 m in man), giving a large surface area and plenty of time for absorption.
- Its inner wall is **folded** and bears numerous finger-like **villi**, and the epithelial cells have **microvilli**: this gives a **very large surface area** for absorption.
- The **epithelium of each villus is only one cell thick**, so the **diffusion distance is short**.
- Each villus has a dense network of **blood capillaries**, with a thin wall, which carries away glucose and amino acids rapidly, **maintaining a steep concentration gradient**.
- Each villus has a **lacteal** (lymph vessel) that absorbs **fatty acids and glycerol**.
- The epithelial cells contain many **mitochondria** that supply energy for **active transport** of glucose and amino acids.
- The wall has **muscles** which produce **peristalsis** and mix the food with the walls, and the ileum is moist, with mucus.

questions.corrige_markdown:
| Vitamin/mineral | Source | Deficiency | Function |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Vitamin A** | carrots, liver, egg yolk, fish liver oil, dark green vegetables | **night blindness** (poor vision in dim light) | proper vision |
| **Vitamin D** | milk, meat, eggs, fish liver oil (also made in the skin by sunlight) | **rickets** | helps the absorption of calcium and phosphorus; hardening of bones and teeth |
| **Iron** | liver, red meat, beans, green leafy vegetables | **anaemia** | making **haemoglobin** in red blood cells, to carry oxygen |
| **Vitamin C** | oranges, grapes, limes etc. | **scurvy** | prevents bleeding gums; healing of wounds |
| **Calcium** | milk, cheese, fish, eggs, green vegetables | weak bones and teeth, rickets, muscle cramps | helps in muscle contraction; makes bones and teeth; helps blood clotting |
